name: Sparse-view 3D Gaussian Splatting with Depth Priors
definition: Methods targeting 3D reconstruction from sparse-view inputs by introducing depth inputs estimated by a pre-trained 2D network.
summary: Sparse-view 3D Gaussian Splatting with Depth Priors reconstructs 3D scenes from few images by integrating monocular depth estimates to supervise Gaussian optimization, reducing geometric ambiguity.
